pairs.subject: background-jobs
pairs.evidence: src/features/overview/components/health/SystemHealthPanel.tsx:58 The install of node or claude_cli is a watched job: InstallButton draws a progress strip for it. The panel takes only the states and `install` from useAutoInstaller and drops the `cancel` the hook returns, so a running install has no cancel affordance anywhere in this context, and a backend `cancelled` terminal state comes back as the idle install button instead of being shown as cancelled.

techniques.evidence: src/features/overview/components/health/InstallButton.tsx:38 The in-flight branch renders only the progress strip and the last output line, with no cancel control and no cancelling state. The fall-through at :99 renders the idle Install button for any other phase, so `cancelled` (mapped to idle by the hook) collapses into the not-started endpoint instead of being a distinct terminal state.

src/features/overview/components/health/SystemHealthPanel.tsx:77 The only timer in the context is a one-shot delayed re-check that the effect cleanup clears at :78. The context has no recurring loop to register: a search for setInterval, poll and refetchInterval over both directories found nothing.
